title: Eiffel Tower
text: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It was constructed from 1887 to 1889 as the entrance to the 1889 World's Fair.

title: Paris
text: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France, with an estimated population of over 2.1 million residents within city limits.

title: Great Wall of China
text: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications that were built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states to protect against nomadic groups.

title: Water Boiling Point
text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit) at standard atmospheric pressure at sea level.

title: Python Programming
text: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language developed by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

title: COVID-19 Vaccine and Fertility
text: Clinical trials and observational studies of over 1.2 million individuals confirm that the COVID-19 vaccine does not cause infertility or pregnancy complications.

title: COVID-19 Vaccine Authorization
text: The COVID-19 vaccine received official emergency use authorization and subsequent full regulatory approval following Phase 3 multinational randomized clinical trials.

title: Antibiotic Resistance
text: Antibiotics are medicines that fight bacterial infections in people and animals. They do not work against viral infections such as colds or flu.

title: Graphene Properties
text: Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice with exceptional electrical, thermal, and mechanical conductivity.

title: Vaccine Safety in Pregnancy
text: No evidence indicates risk to pregnant women from mRNA vaccination, and maternal antibodies are effectively transferred to infants through placenta and breast milk.

title: Apple iPhone
text: Apple announced the iPhone 15 series in September 2023, introducing an aerospace-grade titanium design and USB-C connectivity.

title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing
text: CRISPR-Cas9 is a genome editing tool that enables geneticists and medical researchers to edit parts of the genome by adding, removing, or altering sections of the DNA sequence.

title: Moon Landing
text: Apollo 11 was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon on July 20, 1969, with astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.

title: Statins and Cardiovascular Disease
text: Statins reduce cardiovascular events and mortality in individuals with established cardiovascular disease by lowering low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels.
